title: Algebraic degree of the binary inner product
statement: For every positive integer $n$, the function on pairs of vectors in $(\mathbb{Z}/2\mathbb{Z})^n$ that sends $(x,y)$ to $\sum_{i=1}^n x_i y_i$ modulo $2$ has algebraic degree exactly $2$.
